technical.summary: ABBV shows long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA alignment) and positive squeeze momentum, but lacks trend strength (ADX 15), short-term price weakness below key MAs, and no triggered entry strategy limit confidence for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying data, minimal retail interest, and elevated volatility risk with earnings 11 days away.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (110+ days old) with small position sizes offering minimal conviction signal.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (350.56), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 11 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ABBV.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term MA alignment (50/200 EMA bullish) + supertrend bullish + extreme fear sentiment (35/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity near support (132.70).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below both 9 and 21 EMAs with no ADX trend strength, earnings volatility in 11 days, crisis VIX, zero fundamental conviction, and no triggered entry strategy make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term MA alignment and extreme fear sentiment offer contrarian appeal, but price weakness below 9/21 EMAs combined with zero ADX trend strength and no triggered entry strategy undermine conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 11 days coupled with crisis VIX and macro headwinds (rising dollar, flat yield curve) create uncontrollable downside risk within swing timeframe.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 22 Health Care positions with existing ABBV exposure; sector concentration and earnings proximity warrant avoidance despite support-level setup.
